title: Constant model of the generic stalk image
statement: Let $X$ be an irreducible scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with generic point $\eta$ [def-sc-generic-point], and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. Let $\varphi:F\to G$ be a monomorphism of $\Lambda$-module sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with $G$ constant [def-constructible-constant]. There exist a $\Lambda$-module $N$ and a monomorphism $\alpha:N_X\to G$ from its constant sheaf, such that for every separably closed field $\Omega$ and geometric point $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ above $\eta$, there is an isomorphism $e_s:(N_X)_s\simeq F_s$ satisfying $e_s\varphi_s=\alpha_s$. Stalks are those of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. No finiteness or extension over an open is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09BH, Proposition 59.74.1 (3), generic submodule and generator-lifting paragraphs

proof.text: Choose a constant presentation i : M_X isomorphic to G and the geometric point s0 given by the separable closure of the residue field at eta. Set N to the stalk of F at s0, and j : N -> M to the composite of the stalk map of phi, the stalk of i inverse, and the canonical constant-stalk isomorphism. The stalk functor preserves monomorphisms by its finite-limit-preservation instance, so j is mono. This directly uses the source stalk as the constant value instead of constructing its isomorphic range submodule.
Define alpha as constantSheaf.map j followed by i.hom. The constant-presheaf functor and left-exact sheafification preserve monomorphisms, so alpha is mono, using their existing Lean instances.

For s over eta take the natural isomorphism beta between the stalk functors at s0 and s, normalized on constants, from the geometric stalk comparison lemma. Define e as the canonical isomorphism from the constant N stalk to N followed by beta at F. The constant-sheaf stalk naturality formula computes the stalk of alpha. Normalize beta at M_X, then use beta naturality for i.hom and phi and cancel i.inv composed with i.hom. This proves the required equality.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09BH (3), generic submodule paragraph; use the source stalk instead of its isomorphic range, with naturality supplying the compatibility equation
